killed.because: The walker-view overlay fails the judge's position/distance/bearing sanity check on the data: the minimap render contradicts its own bearing readouts. EigenMapHud.client.luau:110 projects screen-Y as (py1 - ey) / (py1 - py0), which puts eigen +ey (SOUTH under the module's north = -ey law, EigenMap.luau:107-111) at the TOP of the frame (UDim2 Y-scale 0 is top), while the same HUD pins an 'N ^' label at the top (EigenMapHud.client.luau:213-221) and prints bearings under the north = -ey law. Judge check on the final tree bytes: all 20 directed region pairs are drawn in the wrong direction versus the module's own bearings recomputed from CATHEDRAL_CURVATURE_SCAN_20260927.json (worst deviation 124.1 deg; walker case: water_computer is reported at bearing 35.6 deg from fractal_maze but drawn at 159.7 deg). The module data and math are exact (10/10 pairs equal the JSON recompute, world plate studs and bearing preserved, sha256 stamp matches the scan bytes), and the build does touch roblox/, but the overlay's rendered positions are mirrored north/south against the data's compass, so the kill condition fires on the overlay itself. Candidate one's own falsifier (tools/eigenmap_overlay_check.py, exit 0 under the judge) checks module math only and cannot see this class of defect; the sibling candidate measured the same line independently (eigenmap-two.md Approach).

ruling: eigenmap-two survives because every prong of the judge-run position/distance/bearing check passes on its shipped bytes (data byte-equal to the 0927 scan, module math executed under the luau CLI equal to a Python recompute under the estate bearing law, world plate and minimap both preserving the one compass, worst render-vs-bearing deviation 0.0 deg) while eigenmap-one dies on the mirrored minimap.
critique: The in-Studio runtime leg is still unverified (the candidate's own pre-registered risk (c)): BillboardGui, CFrame strips, portal landing and ShadowLedger touch rows are type-checked and parsed but never executed; the revision must land a Studio smoke test or file that debt with an owner and a date.

Fold the tree: one card now ships two eigen-map builds (two shared data modules, two HUDs, two plates, two portals). The revision must prune the killed candidate's files (roblox/src/shared/EigenMap.luau, roblox/src/server/EigenMapZone.luau, roblox/src/client/EigenMapHud.client.luau, one's init.server.luau hook lines and README bullet) and rebuild the_mountain.rbxlx so the estate carries exactly one cathedral map.

After the prune, re-author the shared surfaces: roblox/README.md's mesh-layer section currently documents both candidates (README:69-93); keep only the surviving build's row plus its falsifier path, and verify the RUNG CLIMBED line in queue/todo.md names the surviving build rather than the killed one.

Move the falsifier into the repo: eigenmap-two-check.py and its luau driver live in the panel cands dir (watch/inbox/ractor_panel_20260926/cands/); relocate them under tools/ the way candidate one did so the README cites a repo-owned, rerunnable check instead of a panel artifact.
